notes.title: Back for 2020 and more!
notes.content:
Join the discord community! 
It links all of our products together and has weekly give aways and events!

You can join [url=https://discord.gg/uEaHFvNaWv]here[/url]!

The first 30 people to join and be part of the channel for 5 hours will get monkey and a rare tier 3 hat for free! (You will need to post steam id when you join so we know which account to give items to!)

We are back in development guys after a long break. Expect more minigames and a fully polished mario party like online board mode experience!

PS: If you have suggestion for minigames or board map themes or items drop by our discord (link above) and post them! If we use your idea we will throw rare hats at you ːsteamhappyː

Edit : Invite link updated.

notes.title: Early Access!
notes.content:
Special thanks to everyone who helped us out in the beta!
Now we are moving onto early access!

The team is currently working hard on board mode and we have made so many changes and fixes along the way since beta. We couldn't have done it without you!

Lets keep going! ːsteamhappyː

We have included a preview of board mode.
You can't do much yet :)

notes.title: New Features
notes.content:
We are still working hard on this for everyone!
We have plenty of new features planned for you.
Here are some that we just finished. :bienfusurprised:

[h1]Keybinds[/h1]
Keybinds are now available in the settings menu!

[h1]New Game Info Screen[/h1]
A new game info screen that shows you all the controls properly and lets you change them!

[h1]A new minigame![/h1]
Try out fruit frenzy! In this minigame you have to run around the beach and avoid monkeys throwing fruit at you!

[h1]Matchmaking Ban Removed[/h1]
Match making ban has been removed!
Join up again straight away if you want!
But remember you get rewards for finishing no matter what happens!

[h1]Partial Controller Support[/h1]
You can now bind your gamepad, like an xbox controller and once in game can play with just your controller! Make sure you ready up with your controller in games like angry monkey to get the controller version!

[h1]Misc Improvements[/h1]
The usual improvements to server and game!

Thanks to everyone for all the support and feedback! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: New Features!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we are working hard on this for you!

We have added the following,

[h1]New Tutorial[/h1]
This should help new players setup their name, character, play a simple basketball game and get their first summon done.

[h1]Summoning[/h1]
Summoning lets you get random items and cards by spending party tickets. There is only one summon option currently but we have many different types planned and will be doing special events and updating the summoning options regularly.

[h1]New Characters[/h1]
48 new characteres, try them out!

[h1]Cards[/h1]
Cards give you different effects when you have them equipped.
For instance they could give you bonus points in certain games, or make you move faster in a certain game. You can equip 6 at once. We are working on upgrading both cards and items so they can be combined and upgraded! Stay tuned.

Thanks to everyone for all the support and feedback! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Open Beta!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
We have entered open beta now!

You can get a key within ten minutes and start playing by signing up [url=https://www.luckykingstudio.com/sfpbeta.html]here[/url]!

Make sure you check your email spam so you don't miss your key.

We are adding challenges and the rewards tree soon!
Until then enjoy match making or lobbies with your friends.

Special thanks to everyone who has been playing and those who are sending feedback. We want to hear from you!

notes.title: Beta Wave 2!

As always you can still signup [url=https://www.luckykingstudio.com/sfpbeta.html]here[/url]. ːsteamhappyː


Thanks for the feedback we have received for everyone. We have added sound controls to the main menu settings thanks to some feedback that went like this

Don't forget you can send us feedback in the game by clicking on send feedback bottom left. We want to build a great game for everyone so let us know your thoughts!
